checks.label: If a number is multiplied by −1, its arrow is turned through 180 degrees: on Taking away the second arrow 2 + j1 swings half round about 0 at full length, lands on −2 − j1 with both parts changed in sign, then slides onto the first arrow's tip

Addition (and hence subtraction) of complex numbers is addition (subtraction) of two-dimensional vectors: for every pair of tips tried on the drag screens, adding and taking away, the second arrow slid onto the first one's tip ends where real with real and j with j land, its parts follow on along the axes to there, and the bold arrow runs from 0 to the same point
An Argand diagram has a horizontal axis, the real axis, and a vertical axis, the imaginary axis: the axes are named real and j, and every dot sits its real part across and its j part up
All four quarters: 3 + j2 sits top right and −2 − j3 bottom left of 0; 4 − j3 sits bottom right, 6 + j0 on the real axis, a pure resistance, and 0 + j4 on the j axis, a pure reactance
Each puzzle takes only its right answer: every answer is named for where its arrows land, and each wrong one lands somewhere else
The order does not matter: laid the other way round, the first arrow on the second one's tip, (4 − j5) + (−3 + j2) finishes on 1 − j3 like (−3 + j2) + (4 − j5), and so does every pair of tips tried

The tips snap to whole steps and stop where every arrow still fits on the plane: a drag to 2.4 across and 1.6 down lands on 2 − j2, one far past the right edge stops at 6 + j0, and taking away keeps the turned arrow and the finish on the plane too
Before an answer, a puzzle's picture shows only the question: its dot or arrows, no sum, no slid arrow and no parts, with one line of working at most

Every demonstration finishes within 4.6 s of its screen opening, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; a switch between Add and Take away, and every answer's motion, right or wrong, within 3 s

From outside the rule: taking away undoes adding, (1 − j3) − (4 − j5) = −3 + j2; and on Lengths do not add the sum 4 + j3 is drawn 5 steps long, as the 3-4-5 right triangle says, while the red mark sits 7 steps out, the two lengths added
